mapper.select: SELECT order_id, user_id, schedule_id, order_position, order_state, order_price, order_time FROM orderinfo WHERE order_id = #{orderId}
SELECT order_id, user_id, schedule_id, order_position, order_state, order_price, order_time FROM orderinfo ORDER BY order_time DESC
SELECT order_id, user_id, schedule_id, order_position, order_state, order_price, order_time FROM orderinfo WHERE schedule_id = #{scheduleId} AND order_state != 2 ORDER BY order_time DESC
SELECT order_id, user_id, schedule_id, order_position, order_state, order_price, order_time FROM orderinfo WHERE order_state = #{orderState} ORDER BY order_time DESC

SELECT o.order_id, o.user_id, o.schedule_id, o.order_position, o.order_state, o.order_price, o.order_time FROM orderinfo o INNER JOIN user u ON o.user_id = u.user_id WHERE u.user_name = #{userName} ORDER BY o.order_time DESC

SELECT o.order_id, o.user_id, o.schedule_id, o.order_position, o.order_state, o.order_price, o.order_time FROM orderinfo o INNER JOIN user u ON o.user_id = u.user_id WHERE u.user_name = #{userName} AND o.order_state = 0 ORDER BY o.order_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orderinfo(order_id, order_position, schedule_id, user_id, order_price, order_time, order_state) VALUES(#{orderId}, #{orderPosition}, #{scheduleId}, #{userId}, #{orderPrice}, #{orderTime}, 1)
mapper.update: UPDATE orderinfo SET order_state = 0 WHERE order_id = #{orderId}
UPDATE orderinfo SET order_state = 2 WHERE order_id = #{orderId}
